headline: WattEV orders 370 Tesla Semi trucks in $100M deal — California's largest-ever single electric truck order; 50 units to be delivered in 2026 with full fleet by end of 2027; 300+ trucks supporting Port of Oakland freight electrification; WattEV CEO said Tesla Semi was chosen based on 'cost, performance, and availability' in a public RFP process — signals accelerating enterprise fleet adoption as Nevada production ramps

Tesla wins S&P Global Mobility 'Overall Loyalty to Make' award for 4th consecutive year — owners returning to Tesla brand at class-leading rates despite Musk political controversy; structural brand loyalty floor confirmed even amid DOGE-related demand headwinds; loyalty data validates that product quality continues to outweigh political backlash

Unsupervised robotaxi fleet grows to 30 total vehicles — Austin: 22 fully driverless (up from 19 on Apr 29), Houston: 6 (up from 3), Dallas: 2; net +5 vehicles in 7 days; fleet operating day and evening hours; Tesla simultaneously parades Cybercab in glass box at Miami's F1 Grand Prix, reaching millions of motorsport fans globally at zero ad spend

Musk settles SEC Twitter disclosure lawsuit for $1.5M — removes long-running SEC overhang on Musk; settlement does not require admission of wrongdoing; trust in Musk's legal exposure clears as Q2 2026 operational focus intensifies on Tesla

RDW presents Tesla FSD case to EU Technical Committee in Brussels — Nordic regulators (Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Norway) raise concerns over FSD allowing speeding, icy road performance, and driver distraction; no vote today; Tesla needs 15/27 EU member states for bloc-wide approval; next vote opportunities: July and October 2026

Reuters investigation: Tesla lobbied Swedish authorities for FSD approval just 4 days after Netherlands greenlight — before regulators had reviewed any documentation; emails show aggressive multi-country push strategy; EU-wide FSD approval by summer 2026 now 'looking increasingly uncertain'

Unsupervised robotaxi fleet reaches 33+ vehicles with hundreds parked and ready across TX — Tesla Robotaxi pricing ~$6.15/ride vs Waymo's $13.93; Dallas and Houston below Austin's fleet density but 100s of robotaxi-marked Model Ys staged in both cities; Cybercabs also staged awaiting deployment authorization

April EU sales surge confirms brand recovery acceleration — France +112% YoY, Sweden +111%, Denmark +102%, Ireland +100%, Romania +53%, Belgium +47%, Netherlands +23%, Switzerland +15%; Europe BEV share hit 20.5% of new car registrations in Q1 2026 (vs 13.2% a year ago)

Tesla insiders sell ~$30M in shares as TSLA hovers near $393 — coincides with FSD 10B mile milestone and Musk SEC settlement; stock drifts slightly lower on the day despite broader Nasdaq setting new intraday records; continued institutional call-buying providing a floor
